question: How many days a year can I work from a different city, and how early do I have to ask?
reference: After confirmation you can work from another city in India for up to 20 days in a calendar year. Ask your manager at least 10 working days in advance.

question: Can I work from another country for a couple of weeks?
reference: Not by default. It needs written approval from both HR and finance, requested at least 8 weeks before the trip.

question: How quickly do I have to respond to a Severity 1 page and how often do I update?
reference: Acknowledge a Severity 1 page within 10 minutes and post a status update every 30 minutes until it is resolved.

question: What do I get for being on call, and what if I get paged during the night?
reference: Each on-call week earns an allowance of INR 2,500. If night-time incident work (22:00 to 06:00) adds up to more than one hour you get one compensatory day off, to be used within 30 days.

question: When does a postmortem have to be written and where is it reviewed?
reference: Severity 1 and 2 incidents need a blameless postmortem within 5 working days. It is reviewed in the weekly reliability meeting on Wednesday at 15:00.

question: What do I need to be considered for a promotion?
reference: At least 12 months at the current level and a rating of 4 or higher in each of the last two cycles, or one rating of 5. Promotions take effect from 1 January.

question: My laptop was stolen. What do I have to do and how fast?
reference: Report it to the IT hotline and the security team within 2 hours and file a police complaint within 24 hours. If it was due to negligence you may have to pay up to 25 percent of the depreciated value.

question: How much can a second monitor cost and who buys it?
reference: A second monitor can cost up to INR 12,000 and IT makes the purchase.

question: Is accidental damage to my laptop covered if it happens twice?
reference: Insurance covers accidental damage once every 2 years per device. A second incident within 2 years means you pay 50 percent of the repair cost.

question: Can I paste client code into an AI chat tool to debug it?
reference: No. Client code, documents and customer data must not be pasted into public AI chat tools. Use only approved assistants and only if the client contract allows it.

question: By when does the weekly status report go to the client?
reference: Every Thursday by 17:00 IST, written by the delivery lead from the notes team members add to the tracker by Wednesday evening.

question: What do I need to do before a visitor comes to the office?
reference: Register the visitor at the front desk at least one hour before arrival with their name and company. Visitors wear a badge and are escorted at all times.

question: How many days of annual leave will I get in my first year if I join in July?
reference: Annual leave is pro-rated from the joining month, so someone joining in July gets 9 days in the first year.

question: How many unused annual leave days can I carry over to next year?
reference: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over. Anything above that lapses on 31 December.

question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
reference: A medical certificate is needed only when you are off for more than 2 days in a row.

question: How much paid maternity and paternity leave does the company give?
reference: Maternity leave is 26 weeks and paternity leave is 10 working days, both fully paid.

question: What are the core hours I need to be available?
reference: Everyone should be available between 11:00 and 16:00 IST on working days.

question: How many days a week can I work remotely as a new joiner?
reference: New joiners work from the office for the first two weeks. After that you can work remotely up to 2 days a week, with your manager approving any change.

question: When do I have to submit my timesheet?
reference: Log your hours in the timesheet tool every Friday before 18:00. Timesheets not submitted by Monday 12:00 are flagged to your manager.

question: How many approvals does a pull request need before it can be merged?
reference: Every pull request needs at least 2 approvals, and one of them must be from a code owner.
